ache.title: Live pull reactions: look at him go
ache.note: Past-Nero explains his Feixiao strategy, then does a live pulling session chasing Eidolons and Light Cones, “keeping budget in mind.” Watch the reactions: the ups and downs are what keep you pulling. Live pulls make spending look like a fun show. It’s someone else’s money and your craving.

videoData.title: Why I Chose Feixiao As My Main | Honkai Star Rail

textData.text: In this episode, I dive deep into the strategy behind pulling for characters in Honkai Star Rail, focusing on Feixiao. We'll explore the reasons behind my choices, the benefits of specific characters and builds, and go through a detailed pulling session with live reactions. Join me as I navigate the ups and downs of gacha mechanics, aiming to enhance my team with key Eidolons and Light Cones. We discuss the potential, challenges, and excitement of building a top-tier team while keeping budget and planning in mind. Let's see what fate has in store for us!
